messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging alert — sustained 5xx increase (18m) affecting hosted inference and Dedicated pool contention.
IncidentBot: Affected pool: dedicated-prod-3 (us-west1) | GPU util 95% | avg latency 2.6s | 5xx rate jumped to 11% over last 5m. Autoscaler failure: quota_exceeded. Likely cloud CPU quota.
IncidentBot: Impact: some Dedicated customers experiencing request failures and degraded streaming. Runbook pinned: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-xxx (ops).

Alex (oncall): Taking this. Pulling autoscaler + pool logs.
Alex (oncall): Saw provisioner errors at ~09:04: `googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'CPUS' exceeded` from provisioning agent.
Alex (oncall): Gateway shows queueing/backpressure; several token buckets near zero.

Priya (sre): Confirmed in cloud console — compute quota in us-west1 exhausted. Quota request typically takes ~30m, so we need stopgap mitigations.

Marco (infra): Options to relieve pressure immediately:
1) Flip Dedicated pool burst reserve (we maintain small regional burst pools) to relieve latency.
2) Temporarily scale down low-priority Dedicated pools and migrate workloads.
3) Apply short-term per-tenant soft rate caps to the top contributors.

Jen (prodops): Proposed order: A) enable burst on dedicated-prod-3 for 30m, B) apply soft tenant caps to top noisy orgs, C) disable non-essential streaming for standard tier. That should hold while quota ticket is processed.

Alex (oncall): Enabling burst now for dedicated-prod-3. Internal API call:
```bash
# enable burst for pool 'dedicated-prod-3' 30min
curl -s -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood.local/pools/dedicated-prod-3/toggle_burst" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"enable":true,"duration_min":30}'
```

Alex (oncall): API responded 200 OK. burst_enabled=true. patch id: burst-3512346789.
Alex (oncall): Pool now reports free_gpus from burst reserve: 5. GPU util dropped to ~80% in ~2 min. 5xx rate trending down to ~4% after 3m. Latency improving.

Priya (sre): Good. Next apply per-tenant soft limits to top two tenants (org-4321, org-8765) to lower QPS ~30%. Use gateway ratelimit override key `ratelimit/tenant_override`. Example payload to admin API: 
```json
{"tenant": "org-4321", "requests_per_minute": 1100, "tier": "soft"}
```
Do we have approval to throttle? CS-alerts-bot please notify impacted customers.

Jen (prodops): CS-alerts-bot: please create high-priority notices for org-4321 and org-8765, tag account teams and sales. Template: "We are applying temporary rate-limits to reduce errors while we remediate; expected 30-45 mins."

CS-alerts-bot: Customer alerts created and dispatched to sales, account owners, and cust-ops.

Marco (infra): Note: autoscaler still unable to provision new machines due to cloud quota. Filed quota ticket #GCP-97442. Provider ETA ~20-40m. Avoid triggering large re-provisions until quota resolved.

Alex (oncall): Applying tenant overrides now via gateway admin:
```bash
curl -X POST https://gateway.admin.internal/ratelimit/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"org-4321","rpm":1100}'
```

Alex (oncall): Overrides applied for org-4321 and org-8765. Observed ~27% request drop from those orgs. Overall 5xx down to ~2.8% and p95 latency ~1.6s.

Priya (sre): Also flip streaming off for `standard` tier for 15 mins — streaming consumes concurrent slots and increases KV pressure. Internal feature flag call: `POST /featureflags/standard/streaming -> false`.

Jen (prodops): Updating incident page and slack #status: short note that burst reserve enabled, tenant soft-limits applied, streaming disabled for standard tier; customer comms sent.

Alex (oncall): Heads-up — burst toggle bypasses some metering; billing event `billing.burst_override` logged (id burst-3512346789). Finance will reconcile.

Marco (infra): Observability tweak: increase autoscaler log retention so handoff has context: `PUT /observability/streams/autoscaler?retention=3h`.

Priya (sre): Runbook follow-ups:
- Track quota ticket GCP-97442 until provisioned.
- Keep burst active until quota bump or until safe scale-down completed.
- Monitor 5xx and tail latency across pools and tenants.
- Gradually remove tenant overrides once stable.
- Postmortem owner: Priya (will file timeline).

Alex (oncall): Handoff in ~10m. Priya, please take primary. I'll leave notes in incident doc.

Priya (sre): Ack — taking primary for next 2 hours. Locking actions: burst stay enabled until 10:10 UTC, tenant overrides auto-expire in 30m. If quota ETA slips beyond 30m will escalate to infra lead + ops director.

Jen (prodops): CS flagged potential SLA risk for org-4321 (99.9% SLO). Sales engaged. No customer PII exposed.

IncidentBot: Safety policy: if 5xx >10% for 5 continuous minutes, system will auto-fallback non-enterprise traffic to model-variant `small-alpha`.

Priya (sre): Good safety net. I'm building the postmortem doc now and capturing command history + timestamps.

Alex (oncall): Thanks all. If 5xx re-spikes, page @pri a (pager). Handoff notes added to incident page.

Priya (sre): Current summary: burst enabled, per-tenant soft caps applied, streaming disabled for standard tier, autoscaler blocked pending cloud quota (ticket GCP-97442). Error rate down to ~2-3%. Customer updates scheduled. Monitoring.

CS-alerts-bot: Follow-up customer update queued for 20m from now.

Marco (infra): Post-incident infra tasks: add `burst_usage` metric per pool and alert when reserve < 2 GPUs. Filed INFRA-2203.

Jen (prodops): Priya is postmortem owner. Timeline + mitigation steps due EOD.

Priya (sre): Will file and include RCA, mitigation steps, and infra action items.

Alex (oncall): Handoff complete.
